AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
https://ag-ui.com

 
 

 
 
The open protocol that connects any agent to any app.
 
 
    
 
 
Docs · Examples · Spec · Discord
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.

items.title: Show HN: Dropbox for AI Skill Files
items.contentSnippet:
I built mdkit, a menu bar app for storing and sharing skill markdown files.
Just drop your .md files into mdkit to store them in the cloud, then drag them out whenever you need them.
Share files by email with viewer or editor permissions. Every save is versioned.
Why I built it: 
I wanted a simple, AI-platform-independent way to share and manage AI skills across teams, with features like editing permissions and version history.
mdkit is in beta and free to try on Windows and Mac.

items.contentSnippet:
I used to use Fabricate a long time ago, its strace based build was a great idea and I always wanted something that could track dependencies so I didn't have to.
KIZZ is that, it tracks your dependencies, and also the order of the build.  It won't rebuild if nothing changes, and can be scripted with literal markdown files with starlark build steps.  I call this building in positive space, not negative space.

items.title: Show HN: DecksMD – local first, Markdown flashcards app and plugin for Obsidian
items.contentSnippet:
I built a flashcards app and plugin for obsidian, based on markdown syntax. You use headers and paragraphs, tables or highlighted text to create flashcards and cloze deletions, which you can then review using FSRS algorithm. Everything stays local, it uses a SQL lite db internally to keep track of state and keep the markdown document clean.
